sources.entry: Time-tracking software is a category of computer software that allows its users to record time spent on tasks or projects.

summary.name: Time-tracking software
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia article describing time-tracking software, a category of programs that record time spent on tasks or projects, including user-activity-monitoring time recorders and timesheet software.
use_cases: tracking time spent on client projects
monitoring time spent on computer activities
summary.what_it_does: The page defines time-tracking software as programs that let users record time spent on tasks or projects. It distinguishes time-recording software, which uses user activity monitoring to log computer activities and time per project and task. It also covers timesheet software, used to maintain timesheets, which was popularized when computers entered offices to automate heavy paperwork for large organizations. The page is a general encyclopedia overview and does not describe a single product.
notable: Distinguishes time-recording software that uses user activity monitoring from timesheet software
Historical note: timesheet software was popularized to automate office paperwork for big organizations
caveats: The article is flagged as having multiple issues and is incomplete
Covers a product category in general rather than a specific tool
